blocks.text: PUERTO GALERA, Oriental Mindoro – The work suspension covering government and private‑sector offices, plus class suspensions across the National Capital Region for the Asean Summit, sent a wave of tourists to Puerto Galera, pushing resort occupancy sharply higher for the long weekend. The country is currently hosting the 11-member Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit, which is due to end on Wednesday, Nov.18.
